raw:
Nell looks toward the locked cupboard.

“Not under the agreement we have. Bea’s allowed us to keep the album here, inventory it, and write condition descriptions. She hasn’t allowed scanning, publication, or public display.”

She taps the relevant line in the binder.

“If a photograph were proposed for the reopening, we’d ask Bea first and get a separate agreement. She wants to speak to people in some of those pictures before deciding anything. Until then, it stays a catalogue item, not exhibition material.”

Nell closes the permissions section and draws the first folder from the trust-owned box toward you.

“That’s exactly the distinction to catch early. Interesting doesn’t mean available.”
